categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The manifest request IDs and params.name match the JSX, but the bound selectedName and directName controls omit the defaults called for by the runtime contract.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The source, list query options, and manual /api/v2/pokemon/{param:name} route match the verified API notes.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: The manual SubFetch instances use literal IDs and supported result callbacks, and SubFetch supplies the stated loading and failure handling.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: The widget includes direct lookup, a searchable loaded-name selector, sprites, types, abilities, and stat bars, but does not arrange browsing and details in the requested responsive result layout.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: A red-accented header and detail cards provide basic hierarchy, but the repeated full detail markup and long sequence of stacked sections feel demo-like.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: All main areas are consecutive Stacks with no responsive list/detail arrangement, so the layout remains a long single column even when more width is available.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: The list has initial, loading, failure, and empty text and each manual query supplies loading and error labels before its success content.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: The searchable selector and direct lookup work as separate flows, but the list and results are vertically separated and entering both names can produce two full detail areas.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: The selected and direct paths duplicate the complete detail card and can render separate results at once, adding substantial repeated JSX and UI.
categoryReasons.accessibility: The controls have visible labels, manual launchers have aria labels, artwork has alt text, and list failures are announced with text.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: The widget only performs read-only PokéAPI GET queries and has no mutating action.

strengths: The list and detail routes match the verified API contract.
The detail output includes artwork, types, abilities, and base-stat progress bars.
Manual lookup launchers specify loading and error messages.
problems: The browse, selected-result, and direct-result sections are all in one vertical Stack rather than a responsive list/detail area.
Selected and direct lookup duplicate the entire result implementation and can show two results simultaneously.
The typed name is passed without trimming or case normalization, and the bound controls have no explicit defaults.
The selector is the only way to choose a loaded name; the rest of the list is not rendered as a visible collection.
fatalProblems: The requested separate responsive list/detail result area is absent: the template places every main section in a single vertical Stack.
highestImpactFixes: Reorganize browsing and a single prioritized result area into a responsive in-widget layout.
Use one detail rendering path for both direct lookup and selected names to remove duplicate output and JSX.
Add defaults to the bound controls and normalize the typed name before passing it to the manual request.
